## 8. Generalisation to UNSEEN phrasing templates

845 tickets written from 20 templates that were removed before splitting, so no model saw these phrasings in training. This is the closest proxy we have for real, differently-worded tickets.

| model | errors | error rate |
|---|---|---|
| Naive Bayes (TF-IDF) | 206 | 24.4% |
| Logistic Regression (TF-IDF) | 137 | 16.2% |
| Linear SVM (TF-IDF) | 231 | 27.3% |
| SBERT + Logistic Regression | 147 | 17.4% |
| DistilBERT (fine-tuned) | 75 | 8.9% |

Templates hardest for Logistic Regression (TF-IDF) (error rate):

- `core:LMS_Portal:23` (90% wrong, true class LMS_Portal) e.g. *hi, notifications from the lms are not coming to my email. please look into it.* -> predicted **IT_WiFi**
- `core:IT_WiFi:23` (68% wrong, true class IT_WiFi) e.g. *Sir, network is down in the entire Block B since 11:15 AM. My student ID is KRM2022MTECH070. Please reply soon.* -> predicted **Hostel_Facilities**
- `core:Academics_Exams:23` (37% wrong, true class Academics_Exams) e.g. *hello, class schedule for block c room shows a lecture that has been cancelled, and the payment of inr 72000 was deducted? please look into it. regards, arjun kulkarni* -> predicted **Fees_Accounts**
- `core:Fees_Accounts:2` (36% wrong, true class Fees_Accounts) e.g. *My scholarship amount has not been credited for the first semester. This is the second time I am reporting this. Kindly help.* -> predicted **Academics_Exams**
- `core:LMS_Portal:8` (13% wrong, true class LMS_Portal) e.g. *Video lectures on the LMS r nt playing, buffering forever, this is affecting my attendance....* -> predicted **IT_WiFi**
- `core:Academics_Exams:17` (11% wrong, true class Hostel_Facilities) e.g. *hello team, practical exam of encs224 clashes with my placement interview on yesterday. please treat this as urgent. need this fixed urgently.* -> predicted **Academics_Exams**

DistilBERT right / Logistic Regression (TF-IDF) wrong: **125** tickets; the reverse: **63**.

| text | category | pred_tfidf_lr |
|---|---|---|
| Sir, need to reset the password of my official email id, the reset link never arrives? Contact me at 9667095212. Kindly help. Thanks, Mr. Riya Mehta | IT_WiFi | Academics_Exams |
| hello, class schedule for block c room shows a lecture that has been cancelled, and the payment of inr 72000 was deducted? please look into it. regards, arjun kulkarni | Academics_Exams | Fees_Accounts |
| Dear Sir class schedule for Blok C room shosw a lecture that has been cancelled and my email password is also not working My exam is tomorrow! | Academics_Exams | IT_WiFi |
| My scholarship amount has not been credited for the first semester. This is the second time I am reporting this. Kindly help. | Fees_Accounts | Academics_Exams |
| Sir, network is down in the entire Block B since 11:15 AM. My student ID is KRM2022MTECH070. Please reply soon. | IT_WiFi | Hostel_Facilities |
| hi, notifications from the lms are not coming to my email. please look into it. | LMS_Portal | IT_WiFi |

Interpretation: on new wording the sparse models only have overlapping *words*; when the decisive words were never seen with the right class, they fall back on generic cue words (portal, payment, room...). The pretrained transformer maps paraphrases close together, so it degrades far less. This, not the in-distribution score, is the evidence for the transformer.

## 9. NER edge cases (gold sample)

Strict micro-F1 **0.968**, lenient micro-F1 **0.968**; tickets with every entity correct: **42/50**.

### Missed entities

| entity | label | predicted instead | ticket |
|---|---|---|---|
| err-504 | ERROR_CODE | - | VPN gives ERR-504 every time I connect from home. |
| e1021 | ERROR_CODE | - | Fee payment portal throws E1021 at the last step. |
| cse-205 | COURSE_CODE | - | Result of CSE-205 shows absent though I wrote the exam on 14 Oct 2026. |
| lab-3 | LOCATION | - | MATLAB not installed in Lab-3, needed for ETCS301 lab. |
| hostel d 210 | LOCATION | - | Hostel D 210 window broken, hostel office not responding. |

### Spurious / wrongly-labelled entities

| entity | predicted label | ticket |
|---|---|---|
| 5 minutes | TIME | Quiz on Moodle auto-submitted after 5 minutes, error code 408 displayed. |
| night | TIME | Medical room in the girls hostel is closed at night. |
| 2 minutes | TIME | Student portal session expires every 2 minutes, student id KRM2024MCA120. |

Typical causes: (a) formats not covered by the regex rules (e.g. `ERR-504`, `E1021`, `CSE-205`, `Hostel D 210`, `Lab-3`); (b) the small spaCy model tagging lowercase or domain words as ORG/PERSON; (c) boundary disagreements (titles, prepositions) - handled by the lenient score; (d) generic words like 'library' that are a LOCATION in one sentence and part of a fine description in another.
